content.text: I am not seeing this anymore. Can you confirm that it is still an problem
I just ran it on the lastest stuff (without PR 9). I still see it.
(note that I have things in bin_dir, but that's just because I have both desc and binary files going into the same place currently)
If I run the export on the root resource, this is what it ends up looking like:

export/bin_dir/fcrepo_4.6_rc/rest>ls -latr
total 8
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users  1806 Sep  1 15:53 .ttl
drwxr-xr-x  4 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users   136 Sep  1 15:53 ..
drwxr-xr-x  3 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users   102 Sep  1 15:53 .
Can you run with the latest master?
Sure, here's what it looks like:

/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/fcrepo-import-export-driver/target>java -jar fcrepo-import-export-driver-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar --mode export --binDir /Users/bseeger/Projects/fedora/backup/export/bin_dir --descDir /Users/bseeger/Projects/fedora/backup/export/bin_dir -r http://localhost:8080/fcrepo_4.6_rc/rest/

/export/bin_dir/fcrepo_4.6_rc/rest>ls -latr
total 320
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users    1806 Sep  1 16:03 .ttl
drwxr-xr-x  3 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users     102 Sep  1 16:03 ..
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users  152204 Sep  1 16:03 goats
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users    1834 Sep  1 16:03 asc.ttl
drwxr-xr-x  4 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users     136 Sep  1 16:03 asc
drwxr-xr-x  6 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users     204 Sep  1 16:03 .

├── rest
│   ├── asc
│   │   ├── 336
│   │   │   └── members.ttl
│   │   └── 336.ttl
│   ├── asc.ttl
│   └── goats
└── rest.ttl
Unless, of course, you're not seeing it. Then I need to figure out what's going on with my system.

Running the command shown below, where there is a trailing slash on the repository URL, causes the filename to show up simply as '.ttl' with no actual filename.  A trailing slash should be removed, if present.

comments.body: I am not seeing this anymore. Can you confirm that it is still an problem Bethany Seeger?

I just ran it on the lastest stuff (without PR 9). I still see it.
(note that I have things in bin_dir, but that's just because I have both desc and binary files going into the same place currently)

If I run the export on the root resource, this is what it ends up looking like:

export/bin_dir/fcrepo_4.6_rc/rest>ls -latr
total 8
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users  1806 Sep  1 15:53 .ttl
drwxr-xr-x  4 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users   136 Sep  1 15:53 ..
drwxr-xr-x  3 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users   102 Sep  1 15:53 .
Can you run with the latest master?

Sure, here's what it looks like: 


/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/fcrepo-import-export-driver/target>java -jar fcrepo-import-export-driver-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar --mode export --binDir /Users/bseeger/Projects/fedora/backup/export/bin_dir --descDir /Users/bseeger/Projects/fedora/backup/export/bin_dir -r http://localhost:8080/fcrepo_4.6_rc/rest/

/export/bin_dir/fcrepo_4.6_rc/rest>ls -latr
total 320
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users    1806 Sep  1 16:03 .ttl
drwxr-xr-x  3 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users     102 Sep  1 16:03 ..
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users  152204 Sep  1 16:03 goats
-rw-r--r--  1 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users    1834 Sep  1 16:03 asc.ttl
drwxr-xr-x  4 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users     136 Sep  1 16:03 asc
drwxr-xr-x  6 bseeger  AMHERST\Domain Users     204 Sep  1 16:03 .

Is this not your experience?

It should look like this: 

├── rest
│   ├── asc
│   │   ├── 336
│   │   │   └── members.ttl
│   │   └── 336.ttl
│   ├── asc.ttl
│   └── goats
└── rest.ttl

But instead I get: 

└── rest
    ├── .ttl
    ├── asc
    │   ├── 336
    │   │   └── members.ttl
    │   └── 336.ttl
    ├── asc.ttl
    └── goats

Resolved with PR https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/12

Unless, of course, you're not seeing it. Then I need to figure out what's going on with my system.

Running the command shown below, where there is a trailing slash on the repository URL, causes the filename to show up simply as '.ttl' with no actual filename. A trailing slash should be removed, if present.

`java -jar ../../fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/fcrepo-export/target/fcrepo-export-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar --mode export --resource http://localhost:8080/fcrepo_4.6_rc/rest/ -binDir bin_dir --descDir desc_dir`
